text:
45세 남성 환자, 심한 tetanus로 입원. Puncture wound foot.

BP 140/90 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 32 breaths/min, BT 38.5°C, SpO2 92% room air.

Severe muscle spasms 확인됨.

Diazepam 10 mg IV q8h 적용함.

Nasal cannula 2 L/min 유지함.

Wound debridement 시행함.

NG tube 삽입됨.

I/O strict monitoring 유지함.

환자 상태 drowsy 확인됨.

Neurology consult muscle spasms management 위해 담당의 notify함.
